verdict.rationale: Ollama's code is hosted publicly on GitHub (ollama/ollama), which the evidence pack repeatedly references, implying source visibility, but no citation explicitly states an open-source license (e.g., MIT) or points to a LICENSE file. Community commentary (ollama-comm-8, ollama-comm-12) even alleges Ollama withholds proper attribution/transparency around llama.cpp, casting some doubt on full openness of its practices. missing for 10: explicit license text/confirmation, independent corroboration that the license permits free reading/redistribution.
